unit: one non-merge commit pushed after freeze_at; head = commit, base = parent
truth: product-blind adjudication into adjudication.jsonl (unit_id, finding_id or empty, label defect|not_defect|unresolved, reviewer, evidence); unknown truth stays unresolved
retries: none; a unit that cannot run is recorded with its DEFER reason
code: the checkout that runs each unit is recorded in the trial's executor profile and the corpus ledger; no code, model or prompt change mid-stratum without a new stratum
